title: Book Two · Chapter 132: The Cover and the Date
story:
In the reading room, two notices lie on Ronan's table. They have the same blue border and the same picture at the top.

Miss Wu gives him a question card.

“Which day can a pupil bring a broken book for repair?”

Ronan looks at the first notice. Friday is in large letters. He reaches for his pencil, then stops.

The second notice has Friday crossed out. Tuesday is written below. A date sits at the bottom.

Ronan reads both dates. The second notice has the later date.

He puts the older notice on the left and the newer one on the right. He writes Tuesday on his card.

Miss Wu comes to the table.

“Why not Friday?”

“This one is older. This later notice changes the day.”

“Does it change the room?”

He reads again. “No. The small room beside the stairs.”

She asks him to explain it to a new pupil. A girl from another class sits opposite him. She holds a book with a loose cover.

“Where do I take it?” she asks.

“The small room beside the stairs. On Tuesday after lunch.”

“My brother says Friday.”

Ronan shows both dates.

“That was the earlier notice. This one changes the day.”

The girl turns the newer notice toward herself. She reads it, then puts it back.

“Do I leave the book there?”

Ronan searches the bottom lines. They say pupils must stay for the first check. “Stay there for the first check,” he says. “Do not leave your book and go.”

The girl thanks him and takes the loose book away.

Miss Wu writes a short note on his practice sheet. He can read it from his chair: FINDS THE CHANGE. NEEDS TIME FOR THE LAST LINE.

Ronan feels pleased about the first part and cross about the second.

“I found the last line,” he says.

“Yes. After the question. Next time check the whole notice first.”

He looks at the sheet. Both parts are true. He asks for another notice to try next week.

After the activity, he sees Jun at the stairs.

“Was yours the two blue notices?” Jun asks.

“Yes.”

“I had two red ones. Same picture. Different place.”

“Hard?”

“I nearly missed the small room line.”

Ronan nods. He could tell Jun about his good note. But Jun is telling him about his own page.

“Did you find it?”

“Yes.”

They reach the gate together. Jun turns to meet another friend. Ronan goes home with the practice sheet inside his folder.

At supper, Mum sees Miss Wu's note on the practice sheet. She reads both parts aloud. Ronan does not cover the second with his hand.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

border＝边框；earlier＝更早的；later＝更晚的；loose＝松脱的。

## 理解问题

1. 两张相似通知怎样判断哪张现行？
2. 练习记录既肯定了什么，也指出了什么？

## 读句子

**Ronan / reads / both dates.** Ronan／读／两个日期。
